scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/tirthapada-portfolio run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('artifacts/tirthapada-portfolio/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/tirthapada-portfolio/dist', 'public', {recursive:true, force:true});"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
